decisions.title: Menu/key actions spawn a new thread per click instead of submitting to a serializing executor
decisions.reason: The diff directly replaces all four uiRun-based entry points with kotlin.concurrent.thread { this.pull() } / { this.push() }, so each menu activation or key binding creates a separate thread with no serialization at the call site. Rapid double activation can therefore run pull()/push() concurrently. The newly added private uiRun helper is not used by these call sites, so any intended single-thread executor is bypassed. kotlin.concurrent.thread also defaults to isDaemon=false, so a blocked worker can prevent JVM shutdown. The exact repository corruption depends on pull/push internals, but the concurrency regression follows from the changed code.
